objective_understood: Extend the existing Joyflow human-semiautomatic skeleton so product meaning is confirmed, mechanically bounded, interpreted before non-LEAN execution, reviewed against the original problem, and finally tested by the user.
user_visible_result: The user confirms concrete product behavior, transfers one complete execution Prompt, avoids approving technical implementation details, and can reject a technically correct but practically wrong result.
user_flow_understood: User and Brain confirm a concrete product walkthrough.
Brain creates dual-layer contract, meaning delta, Golden Cases, and user acceptance plan.
Non-LEAN Codex returns read-only interpretation before mutation.
Brain releases one complete execution Prompt after alignment.
Codex implements inside boundary and returns machine evidence and deviation classification.
Brain re-checks original problem and drift.
User performs predefined real product acceptance and remains final closer.
must_preserve: Bridge as only formal mutation carrier.
intended_solution_surface: Routing, bridge, context, interpretation request, execution Prompt, checks, and reconcile scripts.
excluded_changes: No autonomous background agent or automatic merge/deploy behavior.
No user approval of internal implementation design.
No storage of AI hidden reasoning as product truth.
No reuse of the frozen v4.3.5 package identity.
